title: Separate expression values from statement effects
description: You follow a statement executor that updates one environment while running a loop.

steps.description: You define expression nodes for numbers, variables, and binary operations. Assignment, printing, blocks, conditionals, and loops have their own statement nodes.
You return values from evaluate and apply truthy when a statement needs a condition. Variable lookup reads the environment and raises NameError for an absent name.
You assign into env, print evaluated values, and execute block children in order. If selects a branch after evaluating its condition.

steps.question: Does While reuse a saved condition value or evaluate the condition on each pass?
steps.answer: It calls evaluate inside the while test on each pass. The next test can therefore read the body's updated environment.

steps.description: You build a block that updates total and n in the loop, then prints total and the environment. Each execute call receives the same env dictionary.
You inspect the supplied execution result: total is printed, followed by env after. The recorded environment retains both n and total.
